title: Generic generator lifting on an irreducible constant base
statement: Let X be an irreducible scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with generic point eta [def-sc-generic-point], and Lambda a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let phi:F to G be a monomorphism of Lambda-module sheaves on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Assume G is constant [def-constructible-constant] and finite (its geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] are finitely generated). There is an open U containing eta, a finite locally constant sheaf H on U [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant], and a monomorphism H to the pullback of F to U which is epi at every geometric point over eta. No Noetherianity of X, finiteness of the underlying set of Lambda or G, or equality of H and F away from eta is asserted.

source.place: Tag 09BH, Proposition 59.74.1 (3), generator lifting and descent on the irreducible constant base, before the final equality

proof.text: Apply the constant generic-stalk model lemma to obtain a module N and mono alpha from constant N to G, with compatible generic-stalk isomorphisms to F.

At the algebraic-closure point of eta, the stalk of alpha is mono. Its target is finitely generated by IsFiniteSheaf G. Noetherianity makes its source finitely generated, using Module.Finite.of_injective. The constant-stalk isomorphism transfers finite generation to N. The constant N sheaf is locally constant and every stalk is N, hence is finite locally constant.

Use the chosen generic-stalk isomorphism as a stalk factorization of alpha through phi. Apply open factorization of the finite constant map. This gives U containing eta and psi from the pullback of constant N to the pullback of F, with psi composed with the pullback of phi equal to the pullback of alpha. Since pullback preserves monomorphisms, that composite is mono, so psi is mono. Pullback preserves finite local constancy of its source.

For any geometric point s of U above eta, transport the generic model isomorphism at s composed with U.ι using upperStarCompSheafFiberIso. Naturality and the factorization equality show its composite with the stalk of the pullback of phi agrees with the stalk of psi composed with that same mono. Cancel this mono. The stalk map of psi is the transported isomorphism, hence is epi.

lean.statement: theorem exists_open_generic_generating_subsheaf_of_mono_constant {X : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace X] {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] {F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)} (φ : F ⟶ G) [Mono φ] [IsFiniteSheaf G] (hG : G.IsConstant X.smallEtaleTopology) (η : X) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ) : ∃ (U : X.Opens) (_hU : η ∈ U), ∃ (H : Sheaf U.toScheme.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (ψ : H ⟶ (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).obj F), Mono ψ ∧ IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf H ∧ ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U.toScheme), s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = (⟨η, _hU⟩ : U.toScheme) → Epi ((pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.map ψ)
